title: Records voice coach: settings-only preference controls
summary: History VoiceCoachPanel hides voice pack, rest options, one-more/hold toggles, prep count, session mode, and count mode. My Page → Settings keeps all voice coach preferences.
testFocus: Records expanded voice coach: only enable toggle, target reps/interval pickers, hold duration (if applicable), start/stop remain. Settings page voice coach section unchanged. Recommendation page voice coach still shows all controls.

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main

asIs: Records voice coach duplicated many My Page settings controls.
toBe: Records uses saved settings silently; My Page → Settings is the only place to change them.
